01 / Who we are

Your trusted partner in international fresh cut flower trade.

Consolflora Ltd is a Nairobi based flower export company. We buy fresh cut flowers from growers we know and trust, combine orders from several farms into one shipment, and send them to buyers around the world.

Products
Roses · Spray roses · Summer flowers
Clients
Wholesalers, florists, supermarkets and event planners
Head office
Tumaini Estate, Nairobi, Kenya

One partner from farm to buyer

We handle the buying, the checking, the packing, the paperwork and the freight, so that you deal with one team instead of several.

02 / Our vision

Vision and mission

To be the leading, most trusted and most sustainable link between African floriculture and global markets.

Our mission

To connect Africa’s flower farms to markets around the world with fresh, high quality blooms, while promoting sustainable and ethical practices.

Fresh

Temperature controlled handling from grower to buyer.

Ethical

Growers who farm responsibly and support their communities.

On time

Strict cold chain control and dependable delivery worldwide.

03 / What we do

One team.
Every handover.

You can hand us the whole journey or only the part you need. Each stage is also available as its own service.

01

Service 01

Sourcing

We source the flowers you need, negotiate and control prices, consolidate supplier payments and facilitate claims when they arise.

What it includes

  • Sourcing of all types of fresh cut flowers
  • Price negotiation and control
  • Consolidated payment to suppliers
  • Claims processing and facilitation
02

Service 02

Consolidation

Boxes from several farms are combined and labelled as one shipment, helping share freight costs while keeping the order coordinated.

What it includes

  • Box consolidation, labelling and on time delivery
  • Freight booking and coordination with airline agents
  • KEPHIS inspection at the point of export
  • Consolidated invoices, phytosanitary certificates and MAWB
03

Service 03

Intake & quality checks

Flowers are checked as they arrive. The team controls quality and provides postharvest advice so stems stay in good condition on the way out.

What it includes

  • Strict standards and inspections when flowers arrive
  • Quality control and postharvest consultancy
04
SourcingConsolidationQuality checksUplift

Service 04

The full package

Sourcing, consolidation, quality checks, freight coordination and export paperwork are handled together, followed by uplift confirmation after the flight.

What it includes

  • Every task from the three services above, run by one team
  • Follow up after freight to make sure all boxes were uplifted as planned
  • A single point of contact from farm to airport

04 / How a shipment moves

Every order follows the same path.

From the first conversation with a grower to confirmation that every box was uplifted, one team keeps the shipment moving.

  1. 01

    Source

    Work with trusted growers and align the order.

  2. 02

    Receive

    Check incoming flowers and protect quality.

  3. 03

    Consolidate

    Combine boxes and label the shipment as one movement.

  4. 04

    Export

    Coordinate freight, KEPHIS inspection and paperwork.

  5. 05

    Follow up

    Confirm every box was uplifted as planned.

KEPHIS is the Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service.

MAWB is the master air waybill, the document that covers the whole consolidated shipment.

Built for buyers and growers

07 / Why Consolflora

Why buyers and growers work with us

  1. 1

    People who know flowers

    Our team brings decades of experience in floriculture, postharvest management and logistics. We see ourselves as partners in your success, not only suppliers.

  2. 2

    Oversight from start to finish

    We keep watch over sourcing, processing and logistics ourselves. Fewer hand offs means fewer surprises, and quality that stays consistent.

  3. 3

    A cold chain with no gaps

    Our “Keep it cool from A to Z” policy means temperature controlled handling and monitoring the whole way. Modern cold rooms and precise monitoring help each shipment arrive in peak condition.

    GrowerColdroomPackingFreightBuyer
  4. 4

    Responsible sourcing

    We work with growers who use ethical, eco friendly farming methods and who support the communities around them.

  5. 5

    Personal service

    From boutique florists to global retailers, every client gets responsive, personal support from order to delivery.
